mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wishlists (product_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{userId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlists WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wishlists WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT id, product_id, user_id, created_at FROM wishlists WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
